findings.summary: Calculator defaults to 5 years (bad tax year), showing a scary ~30k tax figure first
Only the 'הפקדתם' bar has a shekel figure; 'נשאר בידיים' has no number
Paragraph under bar chart has too many shekel figures; reader can't tell what they end up with
Result range 66,601–66,280 tucked at far left of a long fees line, easy to miss or misread
Salary field requires gross; reader only knows net
Orange 47% tax warning is alarming and reader can't tell if it applies to them
